#include <stdio.h>

/* A block comment
   over several lines. */

// A line comment.

#define SQUARE(x) ((x) * (x))

struct point {
	int x;
	int y;
};

static const char *greeting = "hello\tworld\n";

int add(int a, int b) {
	return a + b;
}

int main(void) {
	struct point p = {1, 2};
	int total = add(p.x, p.y);
	for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
		if (i % 2 == 0) {
			printf("%s %d\n", greeting, SQUARE(i));
		} else {
			continue;
		}
	}
	switch (total) {
	case 3:
		return 0;
	default:
		break;
	}
	return total;
}
